classification.difficultyReason: Identify the nested similar triangles, add the girl's shadow to the lamp-to-girl distance for the larger base, then calculate the height and convert and round to centimetres.

content.prompt: A street lamp is $5$ m high. When a girl stands $6$ m from the base of the lamp her shadow is $1.8$ m long. Calculate the height of the girl, to the nearest centimetre.

spec.description: Editable schematic with the shadow tip, girl and lamp in left-to-right order. Adjacent ground intervals are 1.8 m and 6 m; one straight light ray passes through the girl's top and the lamp's top.
spec.mathematics: The larger triangle has horizontal length 6+1.8=7.8 m and vertical height 5 m. The smaller triangle has horizontal length 1.8 m and unknown girl height.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens are labelled; the girl's height and total ground length are not supplied.

answer.worked:
The lamp-to-shadow-tip distance is $6+1.8=7.8$ m. Let the girl's height be $h$ metres. The triangles are similar.
$$\begin{aligned}\frac{h}{5}&=\frac{1.8}{7.8}\\h&=5\times\frac{1.8}{7.8}\\h&=\frac{15}{13}\text{ m}\\h&=\frac{1500}{13}\text{ cm}\\h&\approx115\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$$
The girl is $115$ cm tall, to the nearest centimetre.
